content: dart:io can only signal a single process — Process.kill and Process.killPid take one pid; killing a process group is a long-standing unimplemented request (dart-lang/sdk#22470), and 'dart run' famously cannot kill its child (#55219). The workaround is to spawn under setsid so the child is a session/process-group leader, then signal the negated pgid so the child and any grandchildren (an interpreter spawning a CLI) all receive it. Correct sequence is SIGTERM, a bounded grace, then SIGKILL — a direct SIGKILL leaves the grandchild orphaned and an in-flight network call unaborted. Critical hazard: once the leader is reaped its pgid may be recycled by an unrelated process, so a negative-pid kill after reap can signal a stranger; guard every group kill with an 'already exited' flag.
